build_vqvae_model: build a VQVAE model with a custom encoder, decoder, and codebook for vector quantization
encode_data_to_tokens: encode input tensor data into discrete token ids using the VQVAE encode method
decode_tokens_to_data: decode token ids back into reconstructed data using the VQVAE decode method
run_vqvae_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the VQVAE model to get decoded output and codebook loss
lookup_codebook_embeddings: lookup quantized embeddings from the codebook given token indices using the VQVAE lookup method
